summary: iter335.17 — Maker rank widget + parallel eligibility (asyncio.gather) + monthly leaderboard rewards cron. Backend pytest suite (10/10) PASSES. Live API endpoints verified via curl on the preview URL: GET /api/settings exposes both leaderboard_enabled and leaderboard_rewards_enabled; GET /api/maker/leaderboard-rank returns 401 without auth, 200 with valid maker JWT, and returns proper {on_leaderboard:false, rank:null, delta:null} for makers with zero activity in the window. Prior iter335 regression (iter335l + iter335m, 17/17) still passes. The asyncio.gather refactor in /promote/channel-split is timing-verified (3×50ms gateways complete in <130ms). Rewards cron registered at day=1, hour=6, minute=0 UTC; tests confirm $20/$10/$5 credit to ranks 1/2/3, marker idempotency, txn idempotency_key 'YYYY-MM:<slug>:rank-N', and admin-toggle respect (no credit + no marker when leaderboard_rewards_enabled=false). All required data-testids exist in MakerRankCard.jsx (maker-rank-card, maker-rank-card-empty, maker-rank-value, maker-rank-delta-up/down/flat/new, maker-rank-cta, maker-rank-link-leaderboard) and SettingsTab.jsx renders setting-toggle-leaderboard_rewards_enabled via the row mapper. NOTE: I could not exercise the rendered maker dashboard end-to-end because the /maker/* route guard rejects locally-injected JWTs (redirects to /maker/login despite valid issue_session_jwt token + cm_maker_jwt/cm_maker_jwt_exp/cm_maker_slug localStorage keys) — likely the guard validates via an /api/maker/me call that has some additional session check. Source-level verification of the component testids + props + backend response is solid; recommend the main agent self-verify the rendered UI via the real magic-link flow if a live screenshot is required. Live preview site_settings RESET to defaults (leaderboard_enabled=true, leaderboard_rewards_enabled=true) per the request.
critical_code_review_comments: leaderboard.py:compute_ranked() is invoked twice per maker rank request (current + 7d-ago). At ~21 makers it's cheap, but at scale this is O(2 × full leaderboard rebuild) per maker dashboard load. Consider memoizing the prev-week computation with a short TTL or persisting daily rank snapshots in a leaderboard_history collection so the delta lookup becomes O(1).

leaderboard.py:_listings_and_views_per_maker() ignores end_iso — it always uses 'now' for listings_total/views_total. Score for 'as of last week' therefore mixes current listing counts with last-week orders/reviews, which slightly inflates the prev_rank score (and so the delta) for makers who shipped new listings between t-7d and now. Edge-case, but worth noting.
settings.py:public_settings — leaderboard_rewards_enabled uses .get(key, True) defensively; everything else accesses by key. Inconsistent but safe.
